title: November 21 — Luotain2: the residue proposes the next physical-law term
summary: A new 674th repository extends Luotain's cheap-probe philosophy from multiplication-table equational logic into spatial/temporal field-law search. FFT-guided residual proposals recovered 44/45 exact +1 equivalent per process-noise level and found a nonlocal link or delayed echo in 20/20 trials. Measurement-noise law identification failed; general photographs and video remain largely outside the sparse grammar's advantage.

nodes.claim: A residue-guided sparse law-discovery instrument for moving 2D fields and causal still-image prediction: FFT cross-correlations propose unrestricted spatial offsets and temporal delays, cheap probes screen candidates, held-out validation decides, coefficients are simplified to fractions and independently re-scored.
nodes.survived: At 2% and 10% process noise it recovered 44/45 exact known laws plus one equivalently predictive conservative Burgers form at each level; nonlocal offset (+17,-9) and 3-frame delayed echo recovered 20/20 where fixed radius-2 stencil and random proposals recovered 0/20. No spurious non-null law on 15 null trials. On a real text image held-out coding improved to 4.066 bpp versus 4.119 fixed-stencil and 4.208 JPEG-LS median.
nodes.killed: With 1% measurement noise it recovered no non-null exact laws, because denoising mixtures beat the true generating equation on observed-data prediction. Natural photos were mostly similar or inferior to fixed/JPEG-LS predictors, and real cockatoo video barely beat hold-last (0.1265 vs 0.1302 NMSE) and lost to dense regression (0.1061). Components are known sparse-regression/FFT techniques; candidate thresholds were tuned on development seeds of the same world families.
nodes.era: November 21: residue starts proposing field laws

edges.why: Luotain2 explicitly names the original Luotain and ports its cheap-probe-before-expensive-validation strategy to data-driven field laws, rather than to implication classes of equational theories.

Both treat what a current operator leaves unexplained as structured information; Luotain2 uses the residual to propose new shift/delay terms rather than preserving signed multiscale pixels losslessly. This is a conceptual convergence, not a direct Sihti-code port.

motifs.title: A residual can propose the next explicit term, but prediction is not identification
motifs.description: Sihti retains what a sieve removes; Luotain rejects most false laws with cheap probes; Luotain2 lets spatial and temporal residual correlations nominate a new term in a readable law. Held-out improvements are useful but measurement noise shows that the best predictor need not equal the generating law.
